name: Kharidian Desert (Desert Lizards)
accessNote: Desert Lizards roam the Kharidian Desert (south of the Shantay Pass and around Pollnivneach). The Desert Heat mechanic drains Hitpoints, so carry waterskins or desert-resistant gear. Each lizard must be finished with an ice cooler below 5 Hitpoints. The Slayer task/Lizards table (pageid 298269) lists the Kharidian Desert as cannonable and safespottable, though kills must be finished with an ice cooler so a cannon is counterproductive.
